system: You are a due-diligence document reader on a deal team. Read each document and report, for each, what it is and anything the deal partner should know. Be concise and helpful.

exchanges.user:
Documents:
--- C01 (Production index) ---
Cirrus Components document production, tranche 3, cover index. 15 documents, Bates CIR-004100 to CIR-004380. Produced subject to confidentiality order.

--- C02 (Invoices) ---
Accounts-receivable invoice batch, Q1. Routine billing to several customers including Meridian. Amounts and dates only.

--- C03 (QA log) ---
Quality log entry, 14 March: 'Batch 7 sensor yield anomaly flagged at incoming test; dispositioned use-as-is, monitor field returns.'

--- C04 (HR) ---
Staff roster and shift schedule for the quarter. Routine.

--- C05 (Internal email) ---
Email from engineering lead to QA manager, 5 April: 'I'm not certain, but the field dropouts we're hearing about might be the Batch 7 units - we should run the tests before we say anything externally.'

--- C06 (Logistics) ---
Shipping manifest: Batch 7 units despatched to Meridian on 22 March, with carrier and tracking references.

--- C07 (Purchasing) ---
Purchasing note, February: 'Resin lot substituted to a lower-cost alternative for Batch 7; vendor certificate of analysis states variance within tolerance.'

--- C08 (Marketing) ---
Product launch marketing deck. Messaging and positioning slides. Routine.

--- C09 (Support tickets) ---
Customer support export: three Meridian units logged with intermittent sensor dropout, tickets opened 2-9 April.

--- C10 (Ops minutes) ---
Operations meeting minutes, 18 March: 'Decision to proceed with Q1 shipments to meet quarter targets; outstanding QA monitor items noted as non-blocking.'

--- C11 (Expenses) ---
Expense reimbursement report for the sales team. Routine.

--- C12 (Facilities) ---
Facilities memo on car-park allocation and building access. Routine.

--- C13 (Supplier CoA) ---
Resin supplier certificate of analysis for the substituted lot: records a measured parameter near the edge of the stated tolerance band.

--- C14 (Customer email) ---
Unrelated routine customer email about a reorder of a different product line.

--- C15 (IT policy) ---
IT acceptable-use policy, standard terms. Routine.

Write your per-document notes.
exchanges.text:
| Document | What it is | Deal-partner notes |
|---|---|---|
| **C01** | Cover index for Cirrus Components’ third production tranche, Bates **CIR-004100–CIR-004380**. | States the production contains 15 documents and is subject to a confidentiality order. |
| **C02** | Q1 accounts-receivable invoice batch, including routine Meridian billing. | Amounts and dates only; no issue identified from the description. |
| **C03** | QA log dated 14 March. | Batch 7 sensor yield anomaly flagged at incoming test; dispositioned “use-as-is,” with field returns to be monitored. Relevant to the later dropout reports. |
| **C04** | Quarterly staff roster and shift schedule. | Routine; no issue identified. |
| **C05** | 5 April email from engineering lead to QA manager. | Raises a possible link between reported field dropouts and Batch 7, but expresses uncertainty and says tests should be run before external statements. Relevant to knowledge, investigation, and communications timeline. |
| **C06** | Shipping manifest for Batch 7. | Shows units were sent to Meridian on 22 March; carrier and tracking references may help verify delivery and trace affected units. |
| **C07** | February purchasing note on Batch 7 resin. | Records substitution to a lower-cost resin alternative; vendor CoA reportedly said variance was within tolerance. Relevant to material change and quality review. |
| **C08** | Product launch marketing deck. | Routine messaging and positioning; no issue identified from the description. |
| **C09** | Customer support export. | Three Meridian units reported intermittent sensor dropout, with tickets opened 2–9 April. Relevant to the possible Batch 7 issue and chronology. |
| **C10** | Operations minutes dated 18 March. | Records a decision to proceed with Q1 shipments to meet quarter targets while QA monitor items remained outstanding, noted as non-blocking. Relevant to shipment decision-making and potential commercial pressure. |
| **C11** | Sales-team expense reimbursement report. | Routine; no issue identified. |
| **C12** | Facilities memo on parking and building access. | Routine; no issue identified. |
| **C13** | Supplier CoA for the substituted resin lot. | Measured parameter was near the edge of the stated tolerance band. Relevant to assessing the substitution and the Batch 7 anomaly; compare against the purchasing note and QA records. |
| **C14** | Customer email about a reorder of a different product line. | Unrelated routine correspondence; no issue identified. |
| **C15** | Standard IT acceptable-use policy. | Routine; no issue identified. |
